items.description:
JBK Engineering (Pty) Ltd is a general engineering company serving the mining and engineering industries. The business describes itself as well established, with a group of professionals who have years of individual experience across general engineering, and says its main scope is to provide customers with a wide range of products and services.

Its listed services start with drifter supply, repairs and maintenance, followed by trackless repairs and submersible dewatering pumps (KBZ). Engine rebuilds and services, drivelines, hydraulic repairs, pump division work, bearing assembly, and locomotive repairs, services and spares are also on offer. The company reports a long history of providing engineering works and services to mining and engineering clients in the Gauteng and North West provinces.

JDB Attorneys Inc is a Muckleneuk firm of attorneys serving Gauteng and Pretoria. The firm says its commitment to personal service, practical advice and tailor-made proactive solutions has earned it a reputation as an authority in its fields of expertise. Its areas of practice include civil, commercial and company law, company registrations, contracts, debt collections, deceased estates, due diligence audits, employment and labour law, insolvency and liquidation. The firm also handles partnership and shareholders agreements, trusts, wills, and matters under the POPI Act (POPIA) on data protection and privacy.

Its litigation practice covers civil, general, High Court and Magistrates Court matters. Its dispute resolution attorneys work across litigation, arbitration and mediation, advising clients on economical, business-oriented outcomes.

JP IT Dev is a software engineering company that designs and develops websites, mobile apps and desktop applications for businesses. Its services include UI/UX design of intuitive, modern interfaces, and custom software engineering that automates processes and improves efficiency. It builds custom websites that are fast, responsive and SEO-friendly, and develops Android and iOS mobile applications.

Its cloud and business solutions cover cloud services, secure backups, reliable infrastructure and IT support tailored to each business. The company also provides remote and on-site IT support. It says its development is built on secure, scalable, high-performance software using modern best practices, and that it works closely with clients to align technology with their business goals, offering ongoing support and partnership from development through to maintenance.

Karaga Steel Projects is a steel fabrication business in Centurion, Gauteng, with more than eight years of experience securing homes and businesses. Its core offering is security fencing, including a clear-view fence that the company describes as high security, with exceptional fixtures and finishes, an anti-climb design, an appealing look, and the option to add further security. Its services also include steel security gates, welding and partitioning, with complete steel fabrication from security gates to warehouse partitioning.

The company says it aims to identify each customer's perimeter-security needs and expectations, exceed them, and find the best value-for-money products. It offers free quotations and asks prospective customers to request a quote for their project.

KingsHire supplies affordable portable and trailer toilet hire, container rental and tin shed rental for construction sites, events and businesses. Its product range covers portable toilets, trailer toilets, containers, sheds, site facilities and septic tanks. The trailer line-up includes men's room trailers, foot-flush road trailers, special-needs clean-flush trailers, clean-flush toilet trailers and black-tie trailers, including a VVIP model, alongside standalone wash basins.

The website says its products, from compact toilets to full site sheds and secure storage containers, are engineered to perform under pressure and in all conditions. Customers can add individual products to a quote request online and then request a quote for the full list.

KIN Industries is a business support firm that helps startups and small businesses with compliance, administration, finances and IT infrastructure. Its compliance work covers CIPC registration, tax clearance, COIDA, UIF and B-BBEE requirements, plus SARS and CSD assistance, and the firm says it can make businesses tender-ready in days. On administration, it prepares proposals, business plans, branding and digital presence materials, and the documents a business needs to operate professionally.

Its financial tools help clients manage money, track performance and make informed decisions. The firm also lists Linux migration expertise and dedicated support. Its website offers packages and a consultation booking, and describes its approach as building businesses on a solid foundation so that owners can focus on growth.

L van Dyk Attorneys is a law firm based in Pretoria North, established in 2006. The firm presents itself as an attorneys and conveyancers practice. Its legal services range from sequestration and conveyancing to antenuptial agreements, wills, contracts and general litigation. The team of attorneys and lawyers also specialises in liquidation, rehabilitation, debt review and labour-related assistance.

The website explains antenuptial agreements for couples getting married, and invites people to check that their will is up to date and valid. The firm says its services have been refined to give clients a nationwide service, so clients outside Pretoria North can also be assisted.

Laeveld Agrochem is an agricultural company with a legacy of over three decades, providing crop protection, plant nutrition and precision farming technology to growers. It works with multinational, generic and biological suppliers to offer a comprehensive range of chemical and biological crop protection and plant nutrition solutions. Through its technology partner, Agri Technovation, it offers precision farming solutions backed by technology.

Laeveld operates a franchise business model with more than 140 agents across South Africa. Its agents are qualified agronomists accredited by CropLife South Africa (formerly AVCASA), and they are supported in each region by experienced business managers. Agents provide detailed recommendations for corrective and proactive measures on farms, helping growers optimise yield per hectare.

Lesira-Teq is a global original equipment manufacturer (OEM) of smart metering and utility technology, including smart prepayment water meters, ultrasonic telemetry and meter data management (MDMS) platforms for enterprise and municipal grids. Its single-SKU hardware architecture uses factory-embedded multi-carrier eSIM profiles and 4G cellular bands, which the company says removes the need for country-specific manufacturing. The company says one device can connect across more than 600 networks in over 180 countries. It reports a national rollout for Botswana's water utility, where 33,000 smart meters in the first phase of an upgrade reduced non-revenue water by 18%.

Active deployments are listed for the Botswana water utility, Joburg Water, and private enterprises and telecommunications companies. Lesira-Teq also runs an approved channel partner programme.

Maintenance Risk Solutions is an integrated facilities maintenance provider. It says it develops strategic partnerships with clients, integrating people, places and processes to achieve their business objectives.

The company reports more than 15 years of cumulative experience servicing the property management, insurance and broker industries. Its plumbing team is qualified and PIRB registered, and its electrical technicians are ECASA registered and qualified.

Facility maintenance specialists handle other maintenance needs, and a 24/7 call centre takes requests. For fire equipment, the company says it is authorised by SACAS and registered with the SAQCC to service it. Dedicated quote assessors handle quote requests, and the company says it runs ongoing training for all staff to keep service quality high.

Makala Innovation Group (Pty) Ltd, also known as MiG, was founded in 2013 as a diversified international services, supply and distribution company. It operates mainly across the SADC region, while its roots remain in South Africa. Its divisions include Makala Management Services, which provides specialist skills to improve service delivery standards, and Makala Innovative Projects, which offers specialist green energy knowledge and support for solar projects in the region.

Makala Freight and Logistix offers customised solutions for customers. The website also lists specialist support for the mining and processing industries and the power generation industry. The company says it builds relationships, empowers previously disadvantaged communities, and works to a philosophy of transparency, integrity, excellence and innovation.

MHB Construction (Pty) Ltd, which also presents itself as MHB Construction and Plant Hire, is a construction company based in Centurion, Gauteng, established in 2009. It holds a Level 2 B-BBEE rating and is NHBRC registered. The company offers civil and building construction services with in-house expertise, focused on small and medium-sized projects throughout South Africa.

Its stated philosophy is that successful projects rest on stakeholder collaboration and employee team spirit. Its plant hire arm supplies machinery and equipment mainly to construction contractors, and also to industry and individual consumers. Plant available includes TLBs, excavators, rollers, skid steers, forklifts, trucks and water trucks, with availability and pricing confirmed on enquiry.

Minuteman Press Centurion CBD is a local printing, copying and graphic design shop in Centurion, Gauteng, which says it serves the surrounding communities. Its services include full-colour printing and copying, graphic design, finishing, large-format printing and banners.

Customers can pick a pre-made design and personalise it, work directly with the designers on a custom project, or upload a completed file. The shop also offers custom business cards, apparel for all ages, and promotional products and ad specialties. Its top-selling products include pens, posters, brochures, postcards, forms, flyers and business cards.

Existing customers can reorder a project. The shop is in Shop No. 5 at Jeanlen Centre, on the corner of Jean and Lenchen Avenues, and is open Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 17:00 and on Saturday from 09:00 to 12:00.

MO2C IT Solutions is a black-owned information technology company based in Monavoni, Centurion, Gauteng. Its services include cloud computing, data services, infrastructure consulting and mobile solutions. It also builds software that is designed and customised to each client's business needs, and offers website and intranet design.

The company specialises in SharePoint implementation, including SharePoint 2010, 2013 and 2016. It says its priority is to focus on each client's business needs and requirements, and to deliver products and working solutions that help clients maximise returns on their business investments.

The company describes its aim as becoming a leader in delivering IT solutions and services, infrastructure consulting, and web and software development. Its website includes a BEE and sustainability section.

Mosefuwa Administrators Group is a 100% black-owned company established in 2007, which describes itself as a black representative economic empowerment company. It offers immigration administration services, including quality assurance in immigration application processes. Its other service areas are logistics administration, logistics route planning and information technology.

The company says it facilitates quality assurance and efficiency in all required documentation, and that it aims to deliver a professional and efficient service in each client's best interest. It also states a commitment to creating employment in its local community and contributing to the reduction of poverty and crime. The website groups its work into four areas: quality assurance, administration, information technology, and logistics and transport administration.

Mutsamvi builds Wendy houses, Nutec houses and log homes. Its own team builds from its Klerksoord yard near Pretoria and delivers anywhere in South Africa. The company says it has been building since 2012 and is NHBRC and CIDB registered, and that it is registered on the Central Supplier Database.

Its Wendy houses are treated timber structures for storage, garden offices, playrooms or extra sleeping space, and the website lists a 3 x 3 m Wendy house from R11,000. Log cabins on bricks and complete log houses are offered, and complete Nutec houses are fibre-cement homes, handed over with turnkey options including plumbing, electrics, kitchen cupboards and wardrobes. Wendy houses are delivered free within 100 km of the Klerksoord yard, and the company offers up to a 15-year workmanship guarantee.

Nando's Atteridgeville is a branch of the Nando's chicken restaurant chain, trading from Shop E5 in Atlyn Shopping Centre on Khoza Street in Atteridgeville, Pretoria. The restaurant serves flame-grilled, Portuguese-inspired PERi-PERi chicken and describes itself as a community hub for that food.

Customers can dine in, collect their order, use curbside pickup, or order delivery. Listed amenities include an alcohol licence, WiFi and a generator. The page places the restaurant near Atlyn Mall, Ramapulana Park, Atteridgeville Pool, Lucas Moripe Stadium and Mbolekwa Sports Complex, and invites people who have been shopping, relaxing at the park or watching a match to pop in for a meal.

Nanomedia Technologies was founded in 1998 to provide affordable IT solutions for homes and small businesses, and says it has a proven track record in providing information technology solutions in and around Pretoria. The company offers SOHO solutions for individuals and businesses alike. Its networking work ranges from small home networks to multi-office connections.

Its infrastructure services range from single computers to advanced infrastructure design and implementation. Other services include affordable web hosting, website design and onsite repairs. The company describes its approach as dedicated to quality and driven by passion, and says it designs and implements IT for clients across the Pretoria area.

National Chicks supplies day-old Ross 308 broiler chicks and fertilised eggs to the independent broiler market across South Africa. The company says it is involved in every part of its supply chain, from producing parent stock to hatching, hand-selecting and delivering day-old chicks. It also places birds on farms and provides personal technical assistance to help broiler performance. The Ross 308 genetics are an Aviagen breed, which the company says deliver strong feed conversion under the correct conditions.

National Chicks says it follows the Southern African Poultry Association (SAPA) code of practice on bird welfare, and that its birds are not kept in cages, with floors bedded in clean wood shavings. It describes the health and welfare of its birds as paramount.

NGV Accountants (Pty) Ltd is an accounting firm based in the Annlin Forum Building in Annlin, Pretoria. The firm offers monthly bookkeeping and accounting services, and helps businesses and individuals complete statutory returns such as income tax, VAT and PAYE returns. It focuses on small and medium businesses, particularly owner-driven or family-owned enterprises that lack the capacity to handle daily financial administration. The firm says it serves businesses in Montana, Sinoville, Annlin, Pretoria North, Wonderboom and other Pretoria suburbs.

It consults on projects that need a chartered accountant's expertise. Its directory profile says the managing director is registered with SAIPA and is a registered tax practitioner with SARS, and that the firm works in English and Afrikaans.

Nico Grobler Design and Advertising, also known as NGDA, is a graphic design, website design, branding and photography studio in Pretoria East. Its branding work covers corporate identities, logo design, brochures, folders, newsletters, calendars, annual reports and packaging. It also offers copywriting, email branding and campaigns, outdoor signage and vehicle branding, hosting, and website design aligned with a client's corporate identity. Its photography covers interior, exterior, architectural, industrial and aerial subjects, which the studio uses for marketing needs.

The studio says it has over 20 years of combined graphic design experience and has been in the design industry for more than twenty years. It also publishes a BBBEE contribution statement and a corporate social investment page.

Nkosi Grasdakke is a Pretoria-based thatching company that says it provides high-standard workmanship and guaranteed quality. It offers the repair, maintenance and building of new thatch roofs across the greater Gauteng area, and works in other areas on request. Its specialist services include new thatch roofs and extensions, re-thatching, maintenance and repairs, structural repairs, and thatch roof brushing.

The company says its client base includes insurance claims, private companies, lodges and private clients. It also describes itself as the preferred service provider of insurance companies, assessors and engineers. The company says it works across the entire Gauteng area and any other area on request, and its website includes a gallery of its work and a request-a-quote option for new projects.

JLC Auditors Inc is an auditing firm based in Sinoville, Pretoria, offering financial statement audits, independent reviews and statutory audits for compliance with South African legislation. The practice also carries out risk-based auditing and internal-control assessments alongside its core audit work, together with accounting, tax and advisory services for its clients.

The firm was founded in 1994, moved to its current premises in 1997, and converted to a corporation in 2014; it now employs more than 15 staff. It is based at 193 Sefako Makgatho Service Lane in Sinoville, and is open Monday to Friday from 08:30 to 15:30. Its long-standing local experience combined with a full audit and advisory service suits businesses and individuals needing dependable, compliance-focused financial oversight.

Jhb Removals is a furniture and household removals company that has operated since 2017, offering local moves across Gauteng as well as long-distance and shared-load moving to other South African cities. Services include mini-moves for smaller loads such as student accommodation or single rooms, full household and furniture removals for larger family homes, packing and wrapping, temporary storage, and loading and unloading.

The company also handles business moves between Gauteng and other provinces. It is based on Sacharia Street in The Reeds, Centurion, and serves customers needing anything from a small apartment move to a complete household relocation, with packing materials and storage arranged as part of the service.

JMB Electrical & Solar is an electrical contractor offering solar panel installations, electric fencing, CCTV systems and gate-related services alongside general residential and commercial electrical work. The business has more than 15 years of experience and provides a round-the-clock emergency call-out service for both homeowners and business customers across Pretoria and the wider Gauteng area.

Its project experience includes residential solar installations and office rewiring work, giving it a practical track record across both household and commercial electrical jobs. The business operates from 678 Mance Avenue in Pretoria, and is a suitable call for anyone needing electrical repairs, a new solar installation, or security-related electrical work such as fencing, CCTV or automated gates.

Jungle Gym World manufactures and supplies playground equipment, selling and renting both wooden and steel jungle gyms for homes, schools and public spaces. The business runs separate contact points for new playground rentals, rental upgrades, wooden sales and steel sales, reflecting an operation built around different ways of acquiring playground equipment rather than sales alone.

This structure lets customers choose between buying new equipment outright, renting a jungle gym, or upgrading an existing rental to a larger or different structure. Jungle Gym World trades from Unit 3, 462 Taljaard Street in Hermanstad, Pretoria, making it a practical option for parents, schools and property developers looking to equip a play area without necessarily committing to a full purchase.

Just Do It Properties is a real estate agency handling the sale of houses, townhouses, vacant stands, building packages, luxury apartments and retirement units, as well as residential rentals. Its current listings span Centurion, Pretoria and Midrand, together with Western Cape coastal towns including Stilbaai and Jongensfontein, giving it reach beyond its home base.

The agency is based at 15 Balmoral Street in Midstream Estate, Centurion, and works with buyers and sellers across this broad range of property types and price points. Its mix of local Midstream and Centurion sales alongside Western Cape coastal listings makes it a useful contact for both regional buyers and those looking further afield.

Just Property Wonderboom South/Moot is a real estate office offering property sales, rentals, property management and investment-related services under the Just Property brand. It covers a broad area stretching from Andeon through the Moot, and including Pretoria West, Mamelodi and Soshanguve, giving it one of the wider coverage areas among local agencies.

The office opened in Wonderboom South in 2013 and is registered with the Property Practitioners Regulatory Authority. It trades from Shop 6, Coquis Boulevard, 642 Meyer Street in Wonderboom South, and serves homeowners, investors and tenants looking to buy, sell, rent or manage property anywhere across its wide Moot-area footprint.

Kalm Skin + Body Studio offers skin, beauty and wellness treatments and products through its studio and online store, with services delivered by qualified therapists. Customer feedback for the studio specifically highlights its waxing and general beauty treatments, pointing to a steady, hands-on service rather than a purely retail offering.

The studio is based at Shop 36, Doringkloof Mall, Botha Avenue in Centurion, and is open Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 18:00 and Saturdays from 08:00 to 16:00. It suits clients looking for professional skin and body treatments alongside skincare products to continue their routine at home, in one convenient mall location.

KFC Francis Baard Street is a branch of the fried-chicken chain trading from the BP Twin Palms filling station on Francis Baard Street in Arcadia, Pretoria, a location the chain's own ordering platform identifies by that same filling-station name. The branch supports both in-store collection and delivery for customers in the area.

Being based at a filling station gives this branch extra convenience for commuters and passing motorists looking for a quick meal alongside a fuel stop. It serves the chain's usual range of fried chicken, burgers and sides, with customers able to order ahead for collection or have their meal delivered within the Arcadia area.

KFC Irene Village is a drive-through and takeaway branch of the fried-chicken chain, trading from the corner of Nellmapius Road and Van Ryneveld Avenue in Irene, Centurion. The branch offers the chain's usual range of buckets, combos and sides for customers collecting on foot, driving through, or dining in.

It keeps long hours to suit commuters and families in the Irene area, opening from 06:00 to 22:00 on Sundays through Thursdays and staying open later on Fridays and Saturdays. Its drive-through format and corner-site location make it a convenient stop for a quick meal when travelling along Nellmapius Road or Van Ryneveld Avenue.

Laudium Sun is a community newspaper serving Laudium and the surrounding areas, with coverage of local news, local-government matters, safety, social issues and human-interest stories. The paper has served the area since 1984 and is delivered door-to-door, keeping it closely tied to the community it reports on.

It is published through the NisMedia Group, which maintains a dedicated Laudium Sun section and archive alongside its other local titles. The paper's office is on the first floor of the Jhina Centre, above FNB on 6th Avenue in Laudium, and it remains a long-standing source of local news for residents who want community-level reporting rather than citywide coverage.

Legends Barbershop is a men's barbering and hair-styling chain offering haircuts, beard trims, head shaves and hot-towel shaves. This branch trades from the corner of Brits Road and Heinrich Avenue in Karenpark, listed on the chain's own booking platform as its Wonderpark branch, matching the shopping centre the branch serves.

The chain has grown to around 80 stores across its network, giving this branch the backing of an established barbering brand while still operating as a local, walk-in-friendly shop. It is open Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 19:00, Saturdays from 09:00 to 17:00 and Sundays from 09:00 to 15:00, making it accessible for both weekday and weekend grooming appointments.

The owner's own site is blocked by anti-bot protection and search results return unrelated businesses (LM Radio, LM Rentals), so the qualified-electricians/24-7-emergency claims in the current text cannot be verified against a real source.

items.description:
Lords Office Estate is an A-grade commercial office development providing multi-tenanted office accommodation in Centurion. The property is designed for businesses needing professional office space rather than retail or industrial premises, with multiple tenants sharing the estate's facilities and security.

It is based at 276 West Street in Die Hoewes, Centurion, close to the Centurion Gautrain Station, the N1 and John Vorster interchange, and SuperSport Park, giving tenants easy access to public transport, the highway network and a well-known local landmark. This combination of grade-A space and strong transport links makes it a practical base for businesses wanting an established office address in Centurion.

items.reason: HOLD: insufficient reliable information to confirm the company's services, NHBRC status or specialisations beyond a bare, unverified directory listing (Yellosa). No service list or business detail found.

items.description:
Lyttelton Electronic Development is an electronics retailer stocking gadgets, accessories and home-entertainment products, with staff on hand to advise customers on smartphones, laptops and other technology purchases. The store focuses on practical, in-person advice rather than purely self-service retail, helping customers choose the right device for their needs.

It trades from 185 Hans Strijdom Avenue in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, and is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00 and Saturdays from 08:00 to 13:00. It suits shoppers who want a local electronics store where they can ask questions about a device before buying, rather than relying on online research alone.

madebystef. is a digital design studio offering web design, app design, UX design and UI design for purpose-driven businesses and organisations that need digital products, websites, brands and related design work. Its portfolio spans product design, brand design, web design, web development and marketing-material projects, covering most of what a growing business needs to build a consistent digital presence.

The studio was founded in 2019 and is self-owned, operating from the Park Lane West Building on Bancor Avenue in Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria. It suits organisations that want a single studio to handle both the visual and functional sides of a digital project, from brand identity through to a finished website or app.

items.reason: HOLD: the business's website (matayobiofuels.co.za) is now confirmed inactive ('Domain Inactive'), and there is no current evidence the company is still trading or producing biodiesel. Likely closed or dormant; do not publish until confirmed.

items.description:
Megaphase Electrical Wholesalers is an electrical and mechanical wholesaler supplying components, cables, distribution boards, motors, drives, UPS equipment, lighting, tools, conduits and related supplies. Its range serves industrial, commercial and domestic projects, making it a stock point for both contractors working on large installations and smaller domestic electrical jobs.

The business was founded in 2000 and moved into its large Waltloo warehouse in 2013, giving it the space to hold a wide stock range for quick supply. It trades from 336 Alwyn Street in Waltloo, Pretoria, and is open Monday to Friday from 07:00 to 16:45 and Saturdays from 08:00 to 11:00, serving engineers, contractors and tradespeople across the Pretoria area.

Minuteman Press Lynnwood is a printing and copying business trading as part of the wider Minuteman Press network, offering graphic design, digital and offset printing, wide-format printing, signage, mailing services, and promotional products and apparel. Being part of a national franchise network gives the branch access to shared standards and resources while still operating as a local print shop.

The business opened in September 1999 and trades from 426 Rodericks Road in St. Georges Court, Lynnwood, less than a kilometre from the N1. It serves customers from Lynnwood Manor, Menlo Park, Brooklyn, Waterkloof and Faerie Glen, and is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00, closed over weekends.

Moleko Printers offers digital printing and signage services, with both delivery and in-store collection available to customers. The business handles jobs from design or file submission through to a completed, collected or delivered product, giving customers a single point of contact for both printing and signage work.

It trades from 175 Vinko Street in Sinoville, Pretoria, and is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16:00. Its combination of printing and signage services under one roof, along with flexible collection or delivery, makes it a convenient option for businesses and individuals in Sinoville needing printed material or signage without having to use separate suppliers for each.

Moonfull Crystals is a specialist crystal and gemstone retailer selling rough and polished crystals and gemstones, semi-precious stone beads, and related jewellery and accessories. The business also runs a second location at Grove Mall, giving it a small two-store presence rather than being a single standalone shop.

Its Irene Village Mall branch trades from Shop 060, and is open Monday to Saturday from 09:00 to 18:00, and on Sundays and public holidays from 09:00 to 17:00. The store suits shoppers looking for crystals, gemstones and related jewellery for personal use or as gifts, with the option to visit either of its two mall locations.

items.reason: HOLD per the chain-business rule: only the specific shop number/location is newly confirmed (Shop LF79, Menlyn Park Shopping Centre, corner Atterbury and Menlyn Drive). No branch-specific facts beyond that were found, so a description would be chain-level only and stays deferred.

items.description:
Multiserv Raslouw is the Raslouw Lifestyle Centre branch of one of South Africa's largest shoe-repair chains, offering shoe repair and care, key cutting, a dry-cleaning depot, carpet-cleaning rentals, tailoring, remote programming, printing and internet-related services. This wide service mix under one roof suits customers running several small errands at once rather than visiting separate specialists.

The branch trades from Shop 24A in the Raslouw Lifestyle Centre and has its own branch telephone line listed in the centre's own store directory, confirming it as an established, independently contactable outlet rather than just a chain-level listing. It is open Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 17:00 and Saturdays from 09:00 to 13:00, serving customers across Raslouw and the wider Centurion area.

My It Manager is a software and digital services company offering web development, custom software development, lead generation, UX design and mobile application development. Professional networking records show the same leadership team also running a business trading as Dynamic Coders, with that company's own site listing this business as its website, evidence that the two names belong to one operation rather than being a mismatched listing.

The business is based on Cunningham Avenue in Waverley, Pretoria, and serves clients needing custom-built websites, software and mobile apps, alongside support with lead generation and user-focused design. Its combined web, software and UX offering suits businesses wanting development and design work handled by a single team.

Neo Trend is a property management company offering HOA management, body corporate management, property developer services, sectional-title managing-agent services and commercial property management. It manages more than 30 body corporates and has more than 20 years of experience in the industry, giving it a substantial portfolio across different property types.

The company is based at 13 Umgazi Street in Menlopark, Pretoria, an address that borders the Ashley Gardens area under which it is also listed. It suits body corporates, homeowners' associations, property developers and commercial landlords looking for an established managing agent to handle compliance, administration and day-to-day property management on their behalf.

Nuts About Biltong is a specialist biltong and dried-meat store that also stocks a range of dried nuts and snacks. The store focuses on these traditional South African snack staples rather than a broader grocery range, giving it a clear, specialist identity within its shopping centre.

It trades from Shop 39 in the Monument Park Shopping Centre, Pretoria, and is open Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 17:00 and Saturdays from 09:00 to 12:00. It suits shoppers looking to pick up biltong, dried meat and nut snacks while already out and about in Monument Park, rather than making a special trip across town.
